title: Feedback Alpha: Nexus Genesis: The Age of Echoes (v0.5.1)
author: Alternative-Dirt-917

comments.author: cxfoulke
comments.body:
I did the trial combat... as a big TCG guy id say nothing really stands out right away. Like theres no oh this is unique or interesting its just  very generic effects of spawn units cast spell that deals direct damage. It might exist in the game overall but no mechanics in the core game to drive uniqueness is gonna hurt. 

There is a million tcgs where you have life, mana that generates, draw 1 card a turn etc. 

If there is something unique about your cards but your worried about complexity scaring people off... at this point in the tcg world  dont be too worried a majority of the people who will play a tcg have played magic/one piece etc    better they can see your game has depth and what makes it special

replies.author: Alternative-Dirt-917
replies.body:
Thanks for the honest feedback, that’s a fair concern. The trial combat was intentionally designed as a very simple introduction, but if it makes the game feel generic, then I’ve probably hidden its distinctive mechanics for too long.

I agree that experienced TCG players won’t be scared away by a little complexity if it immediately shows what makes the game special. I’ll look at introducing those mechanics earlier rather than relying on the familiar life/mana/draw structure to carry the first impression. Really useful feedback!
